text:
elaine: quick kickoff: we need a short handoff doc for the private-deploy upgrade orchestrator. goal: safe operator transitions for VPC/on-prem customers while preserving tenant IPs and supporting customer-managed routing.
bobby: +1. capture three installer presets (airgap, compat-shim, greenfield-minimal) and map to customer roles.
mina: add explicit preflight checks for customer-managed BGP (ASNs, route acceptance) and an MTU probe for onprem.
carlos: packaging note: preflight should verify artifact sha256, RBAC for CRD ops, kubelet version, and node MTU; include quick commands.
elaine: orchestrator requirements: operator image pinned by digest, dual-schema CRD support during handoff, marker CRD for status, and per-tenant rollout events emitted to control plane.
bobby: proposal: `UpgradePolicy` manifest snippet with staged ramps and rollbackWindow. include sample `kubectl patch` for preserving Service clusterIP with caveats.
mina: operatorctl dry-run: prints jsonlines of planned diffs with risk score. very useful for field ops and customers.
product-ops: launch gating asks: e2e tests, two pilots (airgap + VPC), documented SLOs for upgrade failure rate and latency, and support SLA for manual rollback in first 30 days.
carlos: airgap guide: offline bundle format (tar.gz) + signed manifest; include verification commands and HSM notes.
ops-bot: NOTE: emit events: tenant_id, phase, operator_digest, trace_id on phase transitions. ops-bot: created ticket RF-5002 assigned to elaine, bobby, mina, carlos.
elaine: next steps: i'll draft the handoff doc sections: overview, presets, preflight checklist, orchestrator design (dry-run, marker CRD, events), routing tests, packaging matrix, launch criteria, rollback runbook, troubleshooting.
bobby: i'll draft manifest examples and plan output format.
mina: i'll own routing tests and dual-schema migration notes.
carlos: i'll own packaging/offline bundle guide and MTU probe.
product-ops: will review draft for launch gating once posted.
elaine: please react with :eyes: when you review the draft.
